title: Orbs: Brighter, More Life, Aligned With Their Headlines

intelligence.essence: Shawn added to the circling seat 02:10Z: the orbs must be **brighter, with more life, and aligned with their headlines** — luminous, not glossy, every orb measured on its heading's line.
